# Welcome to Gyro Analyzer

This project measures average turntable speed optically with a stationary phone. Start with the README, user guide and official target instructions. The app is in development; physical target/device acceptance is pending. Keep discussion respectful and in English. Do not share private data, signing material or unreviewed camera images. The Android source remains private. Use Issues for reproducible defects and Discussions for questions and evidence-led comparisons.
